column2: The Imperial army has begun an invasion of Aalst in Selva.{wait}{clear}To the Imperial army, Aalst seems to be no more than a campsite, but the village has been plundered and is in a terrible state.{wait}{clear}Would you save the village from the vile Imperial soldiers?

It seems the village of Kungur in Brasia has become an Imperial army camp.{wait}{clear}Taking advantage of the villagers' helplessness, they raid the tavern, steal wine and carry off young women.{wait}{clear}Won't you please go to Kungur and put an end to this?

The Imperial army has begun marching toward Aarau in Frezelecia.{wait}{clear}The captain leading the army is a master swordsman, and the town watch is no match for him at all. Many people have already been killed.{wait}{clear}If this goes on, there will only be more victims. I'd truly like to ask you to settle this...

The Imperial army has invaded the village of Turla in Hunedoara.{wait}{clear}The villagers say the army includes creatures that aren't human, and terribly cruel acts are being carried out.{wait}{clear}Would you go and stop the Imperial soldiers?
In Adrar, in Kenner, slimes that suck people's blood have appeared and are attacking them.{wait}{clear}Will you go to Adrar before there are many more victims?

A man-eater has appeared in the village of Lida in Cadiz, and it is attacking the villagers.{wait}{clear}Lida is a village on the highway, so the harm is spreading to travelers as well.{wait}{clear}For the people's sake, I'd like you to destroy that man-eater.

A gang of kidnappers has appeared in Taranto in Labirk, and they carry off only women.{wait}{clear}It seems the town watch tried to fight them, but they were no match.{wait}{clear}Won't you please defeat the kidnappers and rescue the women they took?

A sea dragon has appeared at Suore in Labirk.{wait}{clear}Ships can't enter the port, and some ships have even been attacked.{wait}{clear}If this goes on, Bremes Isle will be cut off. Won't you please destroy the sea dragon?

A sea dragon has appeared off the coast of Tyrone on Bremes Isle.{wait}{clear}If it moves toward the port town of Liffey, the damage will only grow.{wait}{clear}Won't you please defeat the sea dragon and protect the port and the ships?

A Venom has appeared in Tarlac and is attacking people on the highway.{wait}{clear}It's close to the border with the Kran region, and I don't think we can leave it be. Won't you please go and destroy it?

A Roc has appeared at Semirara in Ur, and it attacks people again and again.{wait}{clear}It went after the crops before, but never attacked people. For some reason it suddenly turned savage.{wait}{clear}When it attacks from the sky, unarmed villagers can't possibly handle it. Won't you please destroy the Roc?

A huge swarm of giant centipedes has appeared near the town of Lamia in Lefkas.{wait}{clear}It's on the highway, and the town's soldiers went to deal with them, but they couldn't handle them at all.{wait}{clear}Before the harm spreads along the highway, would you go and destroy them?

A shadow that moves eerily has appeared on the highway in Brasia.{wait}{clear}It is heading south along the highway, silently attacking anyone who passes by.{wait}{clear}I think it's some kind of undead monster, but no one knows exactly what it is.{wait}{clear}Won't you please find out what the monster is and destroy it?

They say a woman's sobbing can be heard at night on the outskirts of Lugoj in Linares.{wait}{clear}The villagers find it eerie and avoid going outside.{wait}{clear}But because of that, travelers passing through at night can't even find lodging, and some have been attacked by monsters.{wait}{clear}Won't you please find out what that sobbing really is?

A band of thieves has appeared in Manaus in Ares and is troubling the people.{wait}{clear}There don't seem to be many of them, but they're very quick, and the villagers can't stop their raids.{wait}{clear}Won't you please go and drive the thieves out?

A band of thieves has appeared in Popo in Ares.{wait}{clear}They raid village after town along the highway, plundering again and again, and the people fear them as the Red Bandits.{wait}{clear}Would you go and drive the bandits out?

The Red Bandits have appeared again, in Cucuta in Ares.{wait}{clear}They're plundering the village of everything, and I've had word that some among them aren't human.{wait}{clear}Would you go and find out whether that's true?

I've learned that nobles' hired guards are secretly gathering in a forest in Cadiz.{wait}{clear}I don't know if there's trouble between nobles or a rebellion being planned, but it's certainly an ominous move.{wait}{clear}Before anything happens, would you go and find out what they truly mean to do?

Giants have appeared on the highway near the border between Basel and the Kingdom of Legrance.{wait}{clear}It's an important highway, so people are greatly troubled.{wait}{clear}And if the giants start moving along the highway, the harm may spread. Before that happens, would you go and drive them out?

Orcs have appeared in the village of Rekai in Ellora.{wait}{clear}The orcs mostly attack livestock. The villagers are desperate to resist, but the difference in strength is too great, and it's all in vain.{wait}{clear}If this goes on, the village will be destroyed. Would you go to Rekai?

A horde of gremlins has appeared in Ticul in Lorca.{wait}{clear}Ticul is the central city on the highway linking Linares, Langusa and Valese, so chaos caused by monsters there will greatly affect other regions too.{wait}{clear}Before the harm spreads to other regions, won't you please destroy the gremlins?

A gorgon has appeared in Torun in Ragnitz.{wait}{clear}The townspeople formed a party to hunt her down, but she seduced some and turned others to stone. They're no match for her at all.{wait}{clear}Won't you please go and put down the gorgon?

A hellhound has appeared in Jotun in Erlanges.{wait}{clear}They say the Imperial knights formed a party to hunt it, but they were no match for it at all.{wait}{clear}And since it's a small, isolated village even within Imperial lands, it may well be abandoned.{wait}{clear}Please, go and destroy the hellhound before that happens.

Whirlwinds of unknown cause are rising in the village of Tete in the Reyforia Forest.{wait}{clear}The sudden whirlwinds keep wrecking houses and injuring villagers.{wait}{clear}Won't you please find out what's causing them?
Grizzlies are on a rampage in Hofuf in Agadir.{wait}{clear}They seem to be looking for food, but they're very savage, and some villagers have been hurt. Won't you please drive the grizzlies off?

A sea dragon has appeared at Rajes in Linares.{wait}{clear}Rajes is a large city facing the sea. The damage and chaos the sea dragon causes are enormous, and people keep leaving the town.{wait}{clear}For the townspeople's sake, won't you please destroy the sea dragon?

There's a band of thieves running wild around Lendia in Linares.{wait}{clear}Lendia sits where the highways run to the coast and inland, so it has many travelers. It must be an easy place for them to work, and the harm keeps growing.{wait}{clear}Before there are any more victims, would you go and drive the thieves out?

People have been vanishing from the village of Wels in Krakow.{wait}{clear}A peddler who visited the village by day says there was no sign of anyone at all, and every house was empty.{wait}{clear}Something has certainly happened to the village. I'd like you to find out what caused it. Will you do it?

In Rize, in Fes in the untamed lands, villagers are being killed.{wait}{clear}It's a gruesome business: in the morning there are pools of blood in the houses and on the edge of the village, yet no one has heard a single scream.{wait}{clear}No one knows what is going on, and the villagers can only tremble in fear.{wait}{clear}Would you look into what is happening in the village of Rize?

In the village of Iona on Bremes Isle, a strange thing is happening: only babies and small children are disappearing.{wait}{clear}Children put to bed at night are gone from their beds by morning, and mothers are driven half mad, one after another.{wait}{clear}It seems the villagers formed a watch, but they can't find the cause.{wait}{clear}To save the children, won't you please find out what's behind it?
Giant spiders have swarmed on the outskirts of the village of Misrata in Rashid, in the untamed lands.{wait}{clear}I'd like you to destroy them before they harm the village...
